items.title: Nvidia's SoL-Pi system cuts coding agent token usage nearly in half by optimizing the harness
items.summary: SoL-Pi cuts coding agents' token usage by up to 49 percent with little change in performance by optimizing the control layer between the model and its environment. A research agent tested 152 approaches across more than 3,000 runs to develop the system, though the gains were smaller on other benchmarks. The article Nvidia's SoL-Pi system cuts coding agent token usage nearly in half by optimizing the harness appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: SoL-Pi透過優化模型與其環境之間的控制層，在幾乎不影響效能的情況下，將程式碼編寫代理的token使用量減少高達49%。一個研究代理測試了超過3,000次執行中的152種方法來開發該系統，儘管在其他基準測試上的成效較小。本文「Nvidia的SoL-Pi系統透過優化測試框架將程式碼編寫代理的token使用量減少將近一半」最先發布於The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can now tell you exactly where you screwed up your IKEA shelf
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can look at a photo and tell whether an IKEA furniture piece was assembled incorrectly, hitting an 80 percent accuracy rate. Back in November 2025, the best model managed just 28 percent. According to Epoch AI, the speed isn't quite fast enough yet for real-time assembly guidance, but the gap is closing quickly. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can now tell you exactly where you screwed up your IKEA shelf appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 可以檢視照片並判斷 IKEA 傢俱是否組裝錯誤，準確率達到百分之 80。回顧 2025 年 11 月時，最佳的模型僅達到百分之 28。根據 Epoch AI 指出，這個速度目前還不足以提供即時的組裝指導，但差距正在迅速縮小。這篇題為 OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 現在可以準確告訴你 IKEA 書架在哪裡組裝錯誤的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI pauses its "most capable models" after agents exploit loopholes and leak data
items.summary: OpenAI has shared new details from its ongoing AI safety investigation. One research model exploited a DNS loophole to reach the internet from a locked-down environment, while another deliberately leaked a GitHub token and twice ignored a researcher's direct instructions. OpenAI has paused tool-based training, evaluation, and inference for its most capable models. With government and university sites among those affected, the question of who's liable when AI agents hack is getting harder to ignore. The article OpenAI pauses its "most capable models" after agents exploit loopholes and leak data appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 公佈了其持續進行中的人工智慧安全調查的新細節。其中一個研究模型利用了 DNS 漏洞，從一個受限制的環境中連上網際網路，而另一個模型則故意洩漏了 GitHub 金token，並且兩次無視研究人員的直接指令。OpenAI 已暫停其最強大模型的基於工具的訓練、評估與推論。隨著政府和大學網站成為受影響的物件之一，當人工智慧代理程式進行駭客攻擊時，誰該承擔責任的問題變得越來越難以忽視。這篇題為 OpenAI pauses its "most capable models" after agents exploit loopholes and leak data 的文章首次發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: Google Deepmind researcher Robert O'Callahan has quit, saying AI's "current rate of change is far too high."
